verdict.rationale: The pack contains no published benchmarks or measured timings backing Homebrew's speed claims. It has only anecdotal community praise for performance improvements and a user saying they look forward to measuring Bootsnap, which is not a published number. Speed benchmarks are a fair axis for a package manager, so lack of evidence means none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see published benchmarks or measured numbers backing the manager's speed claims
